name: Dose-Dense AC followed by PACLitaxel (ddAC-T)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: The sequential dose-dense anthracycline/alkylator-then-taxane cytotoxic backbone is not biomarker-restricted; it is a preferred preoperative/adjuvant regimen across HR-positive/HER2-negative and HR-negative/HER2-negative (TNBC) early breast cancer, and the same ddAC then paclitaxel backbone underlies HER2-positive regimens combined with HER2-targeted therapy (a separate protocol). ER, PR, and HER2 are tested to guide added endocrine therapy (HR-positive) and HER2-directed therapy (HER2-positive), not to select the backbone. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer, Preoperative/Adjuvant Therapy Regimens (BINV-M 2 and 3 of 10; Preferred).

histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC), invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC), and triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC))

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid, H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling before each paclitaxel dose to prevent hypersensitivity; confirm exact schedule against institutional order set.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: give before chemotherapy. AC phase is an anthracycline/alkylator combination; select antiemetic prophylaxis per the NCCN emetic-risk framework (Appendix D). The exact per-regimen tier is designated in the NCCN Antiemesis guideline / order template (not established in the provided sources).

supportiveCare: G-CSF / myeloid growth factor support: REQUIRED. All cycles are given with myeloid growth factor support per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M dosing footnote n; this is integral to the every-14-day (dose-dense) schedule.
Antiemetics: AC phase anthracycline plus cyclophosphamide; prophylaxis per NCCN emetic-risk framework (Appendix D). Specific tier per NCCN Antiemesis order template.
Peripheral neuropathy: monitor during the taxane phase; consider cryotherapy / limb cooling to reduce taxane-induced peripheral neuropathy (BINV-M 1 of 10).
monitoring: LVEF at baseline and cardiac monitoring during anthracycline phase (BINV-M 1 of 10)
liver and renal function before each cycle
peripheral neuropathy assessment during the taxane phase (PACLitaxel)

doseModificationRules.condition: cumulative DOXOrubicin approaching 450 mg/m2 (warn) or 550 mg/m2 (hard cap)
doseModificationRules.text: Track cumulative lifetime anthracycline exposure; 450 mg/m2 warrants review, 550 mg/m2 is the conventional hard cap due to cumulative cardiotoxicity (DeVita 12th ed. lines 19908 to 19919). Physician decides.
Review required. Dose-dense scheduling depends on adequate count recovery with growth factor support; physician decides.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: AC phase (cycles 1 to 4). Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 5 of 10. DOXOrubicin 60 mg/m2 IV day 1, cycled every 14 days for 4 cycles, with myeloid growth factor support (footnote n). ISMP tall-man. Anthracycline cumulative lifetime cardiotoxicity cap applied (warn 450 / hard 550 mg/m2); DeVita 12th ed. lines 19908 to 19919.

provenance.locator: BINV-M 5 of 10, Dose-Dense AC followed by Paclitaxel (dosing), reference 1 (CALGB/intergroup C9741)

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: AC phase (cycles 1 to 4). Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 5 of 10. Cyclophosphamide 600 mg/m2 IV day 1, cycled every 14 days for 4 cycles, with myeloid growth factor support (footnote n).

provenance.locator: BINV-M 5 of 10, Dose-Dense AC followed by Paclitaxel (dosing), reference 1

drugs.name: PACLitaxel
drugs.notes: Taxane phase (cycles 5 to 8), given after completion of the AC phase. Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 5 of 10. PACLitaxel 175 mg/m2 IV day 1, cycled every 14 days for 4 cycles, with myeloid growth factor support (footnote n). ISMP tall-man. Source-stated alternative taxane schedule: PACLitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV weekly for 12 weeks (Dose-Dense AC followed by weekly Paclitaxel, BINV-M 5 of 10, reference 23 Sparano). It is acceptable to change the sequence to taxane followed by AC (BINV-M footnote c).

provenance.locator: BINV-M 5 of 10, Dose-Dense AC followed by Paclitaxel (dosing), reference 1
